'''Charles-Michel Marle''' ({{IPA|fr|ʃaʁlmiʃɛl maʁl}}; born 26 November 1934) is a French [[engineer]] and [[mathematician]], currently a Professor Emeritus at [[Sorbonne University]] (formerly [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]]).<ref>{{cite web|title=Site personnel|url=http://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/|publication-date=}}</ref>

== Biography ==

Charles-Michel Marle completed in 1951 his primary and secondary education in [[Constantine, Algeria]]. He was a pupil of the [[Classe préparatoire aux grandes écoles|preparatory classes for the grandes écoles]] at the {{Interlanguage link|Lycée Émir-Abdelkader|lt=Lycée Bugeaud|fr}} in [[Algiers]]: {{Interlanguage link|Mathématiques supérieures|lt=higher mathematics|fr}} in 1951-1952, then {{Interlanguage link|Mathématiques spéciales|lt=special mathematics|fr}} in 1952-1953. He was admitted to the [[École Polytechnique]] in 1953. When he left this school in 1955, he opted for the [[Corps des mines]].

He did his military service as a [[sub-lieutenant]] at the Engineering School in [[Angers]] from October 1955 to February 1956, then in Algeria during the [[Algerian War|war]] until 30 December 1956.

In 1957 he began attending the [[Mines Paris – PSL|École Nationale Supérieure des Mines]] in Paris and from October 1957 to September 1958 he attended the [[École Nationale Supérieure du Pétrole et des Moteurs|École nationale supérieure du pétrole et des moteurs]] and completed various internships in the oil industry in France and Algeria. Returning to the [[École Polytechnique|École]] des mines in October 1958, his last year of study was interrupted in 1959 by the decision of the Minister of Industry, to send all junior civil servants of category A to Algeria to participate in the [[Constantine Plan]]. He was then attached to the short-lived {{Interlanguage link|Organisation commune des régions sahariennes|lt=Common organisation of the Saharan regions|fr}} and worked in Algiers, the [[Sahara]] and Paris on various industrial projects.

Between 1959 and 1969 he was seconded by the Corps des Mines to the [[French Institute of Petroleum]] (IFP), where he was research engineer, head of department and director of division. While working at this Institute he obtained a degree in mathematics and in 1968 he defended a [[doctoral thesis]] under the supervision of [[André Lichnerowicz]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Charles-Michel Marle - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=61456|access-date=2022-02-10|website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>

In 1969 he changed his career and entered higher education, becoming a lecturer at the [[University of Franche-Comté|University of Besançon]]. In 1975 he moved to [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in Paris, and was appointed professor at this university in 1977. In 1983 he was elected corresponding member of the [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Académie des sciences |url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-M/charles-michel-marle.html |publication-date=}}</ref> 
In 1989, he was appointed visiting professor at the [[University of California at Berkeley]], for a semester of scientific courses, collaborating in particular with professors [[Jerrold E. Marsden]] and [[Alan Weinstein]].
He retired in September 2000 and since then he is [[Professor emeritus|Professor Emeritus]].

Charles-Michel Marle is the great-great-grandson of the grammarian {{Interlanguage link|L. C. Marle|lt=L. C. Marle|fr}} (1799-1860), author of an attempt at [[Reforms of French orthography|spelling reform]] around 1840.

== Scientific work ==
While working at the French Institute of Petroleum, Marle's research focused on fluid flows in [[Porous medium|porous media]], which are being investigated for applications in [[hydrocarbon]] field development.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles |date=1967 |title=Écoulements monophasiques en milieu poreux |trans-title=Monophasic flows in porous media |url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/ecoulementsmono.pdf |journal=Revue de l'Institut français du pétrole |language=fr |volume=22 |issue=10 |pages=1471–1509}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles |date=1982 |title=On macroscopic equations governing multiphase flow with diffusion and chemical reactions in porous media |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/0020722582901185 |journal=International Journal of Engineering Science |language=en |volume=20 |issue=5 |pages=643–662 |doi=10.1016/0020-7225(82)90118-5|url-access=subscription }}</ref> He also published a book on the subject, developing a course that he taught at the École nationale du pétrole et des moteurs.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Marle |first=Charles |title=Les écoulements polyphasiques en milieu poreux |date=1965 |publisher=Éditions technip |edition=1st |location=Paris |language=fr |trans-title=Multiphase flows in porous media}}<br />{{Cite book |last=Marle |first=Charles |title=Les écoulements polyphasiques en milieu poreux |date=1972 |publisher=Éditions technip |edition=2nd revised |location=Paris |language=fr |trans-title=Multiphase flows in porous media}}<br />English translation of the second edition: {{Cite book |last=Marle |first=Charles |title=Multiphase flow in porous media |date=1981 |publisher=Éditions technip |isbn=0-87201-569-6 |location=Paris |oclc=7761249}}</ref>

Transitioning from applied to pure mathematics, in his PhD thesis he worked on [[fluid dynamics]] and the [[Boltzmann equation|Boltzmann relativistic equation]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles |date=1969 |title=Sur l'établissement des équations de l'hydrodynamique des fluides relativistes dissipatifs. I. — L'équation de Boltzmann relativiste |trans-title=On the establishment of the equations of hydrodynamics of relativistic dissipative fluids. I. - The relativistic Boltzmann equation |url=https://eudml.org/doc/75618 |journal=Annales de l'Institut Henri Poincaré A |language=fr |volume=10 |issue=1 |pages=67–126 |issn=0246-0211}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles |date=1969 |title=Sur l'établissement des équations de l'hydrodynamique des fluides relativistes dissipatifs. II. — Méthodes de résolution approchée de l'équation de Boltzmann relativiste |trans-title=On the establishment of equations of hydronynamics of relativistic dissipative fluids. II - Methods of approximated resolution of the relativistic Boltzmann equation |url=https://eudml.org/doc/75619 |journal=Annales de l'Institut Henri Poincaré A |language=fr |volume=10 |issue=2 |pages=127–194 |issn=0246-0211}}</ref>

Since the early 1970s he has worked mainly in the field of [[differential geometry]], notably on [[Hamiltonian group action]]s<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |date=1985 |title=Modèle d'action hamiltonienne d'un groupe de Lie sur une variété symplectique |url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/modele_d_action_hamiltonienne.pdf|journal=Rend. Sem. Mat. Univ. Politecn|language=fr |volume=43 |issue=2 |pages=227–251}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |date=2012 |title=A property of conformally Hamiltonian vector fields; Application to the Kepler problem |url=https://www.aimsciences.org/article/doi/10.3934/jgm.2012.4.181 |journal=Journal of Geometric Mechanics |language=en |volume=4 |issue=2 |pages=181–206 |arxiv=1011.5731 |doi=10.3934/jgm.2012.4.181|s2cid=55931324 }}</ref> and [[Poisson geometry]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dazord |first1=Pierre |last2=Lichnerowicz |first2=André |last3=Marle |first3=Charles-Michel |date=1991 |title=Structure locale des variétés de Jacobi |url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/dalima.pdf|journal=J. Math. Pures Appl.|language=fr |volume=70 |pages=101–152}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |date=2008 |title=Calculus on Lie algebroids, Lie groupoids and Poisson manifolds |url=https://www.impan.pl/pl/wydawnictwa/czasopisma-i-serie-wydawnicze/dissertationes-mathematicae/all/457//88162/calculus-on-lie-algebroids-lie-groupoids-and-poisson-manifolds |journal=Dissertationes Mathematicae |language=pl |volume=457 |pages=1–57 |arxiv=0806.0919 |doi=10.4064/dm457-0-1 |s2cid=14085924 |issn=0012-3862}}</ref> and its applications to [[mechanics]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |date=1990 |title=Géométrie des systèmes mécaniques à liaisons actives |url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/liactives3.pdf|journal=C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris|language=fr |volume=311 |issue=I |pages=839–845}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |date=1995-12-01 |title=Reduction of constrained mechanical systems and stability of relative equilibria |url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/comm95.pdf|journal=Communications in Mathematical Physics |language=en |volume=174 |issue=2 |pages=295–318 |doi=10.1007/BF02099604 |bibcode=1995CMaPh.174..295M |s2cid=14858696 |issn=1432-0916}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |chapter=On Mechanical Systems with a Lie Group as Configuration Space |date=2003 |title=Jean Leray '99 Conference Proceedings |chapter-url=https://marle.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publications/karlskrona.pdf|pages=183–203 |doi=10.1007/978-94-017-2008-3_14 |isbn=978-90-481-6316-8 }}</ref>

With his colleague [[Paulette Libermann]] (1919-2007) he published in 1987 a research-level book on [[symplectic geometry]] and [[geometric mechanics]].<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Libermann |first1=Paulette |author-link=Paulette Libermann |last2=Marle |first2=Charles-Michel |date=1987 |title=Symplectic Geometry and Analytical Mechanics |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-3807-6 |publisher= D. Reidel Publishing Company|location=Dordrecht |language=en-gb |doi=10.1007/978-94-009-3807-6|isbn=978-90-277-2439-7 }}</ref> He has recently published another book, taking up part of the previous one, exposing recent results obtained in this field since 1987.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Marle |first=Charles-Michel |title=Géométrie symplectique et géométrie de Poisson |date=2018 |publisher=Calvage et Mounet |isbn=978-2-916352-70-1 |location=Paris |language=fr |trans-title=Symplectic geometry and Poisson geometry |oclc=1078689959}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==

*    French Academy of sciences laboratory prize for his thesis work, 1973.
*    Member of the [[Société mathématique de France|Mathematical Society of France]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Société Mathématique de France|url=https://smf.emath.fr/|publication-date=}}</ref> the [[Société Française de Physique|French Physical Society]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Société Française de Physique|url=https://www.sfpnet.fr/|publication-date=}}</ref> and the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=American Mathematical Sociéty|url=https://www.ams.org/home/page|publication-date=}}</ref>
